title: net2 gate, round 8e: round 8's students at teacher gain 0.5 as one ensemble with the veto
description: Round 8 (exp-net2-r8-gate3-129) continued round 7's gate3 students for 60 iterations under the veto policy; over their last 10 iterations their beliefs separate better than round 7's (q 0.68 to 0.82 with copies and 0.12 to 0.18 elsewhere, against 0.55 to 0.72 and 0.21 to 0.26; p 0.73 to 0.81 with a stock TCP flow and 0.14 to 0.28 with copies, against 0.63 to 0.72 and 0.21 to 0.35). Here the three seeds at teacher gain 0.5 run as one policy on their mean beliefs with the veto, p's threshold at 0.5 and q's at 0, exactly as round 7e (exp-net2-gate-r7e05-133 passed at gain 0.5), the setting fixed before this gate ran. Teacher gains 1 and 0.5 each get their own gate because the rule keeps the best five-family mean, which leaves copies out. Its policy is in release model-net2-r8e05-cands (named seed 0, the ensemble of seeds 1 to 3). They run next to the fixed rule on net1 v5 (u = 0.25, release model-net1v5) and BBRv3 on the five validation families and as 2 and 4 copies for 30 s, with campaign seed 21. The share rule at k = 0.5 and 1 on net1 v5 also runs, as a reference and not a candidate: it is what the teacher does wherever a stock TCP flow is active, so with the fixed rule it bounds what the student can reach. The rule is unchanged (experiments/net2_ppo_gate_report.py): per link, the mean over a candidate's seeds of its log utility minus the rule's; the candidate kept has the highest five-family mean; the gate passes if it beats the rule in cubic-first-60 and in new-20's competition conditions, each with its 95% interval over links above 0, is at or above the rule on the five-family mean, and is not worse with copies beyond its interval. A candidate that passes runs once on the test links. Validation links only.
prepare: (cd "$IN/c" && sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS); (cd "$IN/m" && sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS); uv run python experiments/share_rule_export.py "$OUT/share" "$IN/m/net1v5.pt" --u0 0.25 --k 0.5 1; P=(--policy "rule-v5=$IN/m/rule-u0.25.onnx" --policy "share-k0.5=$OUT/share/share-u0.25-k0.5.onnx" --policy "share-k1=$OUT/share/share-u0.25-k1.onnx"); for f in "$IN"/c/ppo-*.onnx; do P+=(--policy "$(basename "$f" .onnx)=$f"); done; experiments/rule_eval.sh "$OUT" val 21 21 bbr3 "${P[@]}"; uv run python experiments/copies.py "$OUT/copies" --split val --duration-ms 30000 --seed 21 --n 2 4 --stock bbr3 "${P[@]}"; mv "$OUT/copies/c-copies-30s" "$OUT/"; jq -s add "$OUT/aliases.json" "$OUT/copies/aliases.json" > "$OUT/a.json"; mv "$OUT/a.json" "$OUT/aliases.json"
run: for c in "$OUT"/c-*; do uv run expliccit campaign run "$c" --shard "$SHARD/$SHARDS" --build "$UML" --workers "$WORKERS" --tables steps; done; uv run python experiments/slim_steps.py "$OUT"
collect: uv run python experiments/rule_report.py "$OUT" --apart copies-30s && mv "$OUT/summary.md" "$OUT/against-bbr3.md" && uv run python experiments/net2_ppo_gate_report.py "$OUT"
